units.reading_scope: selected original sections, methods and boundaries

evidence_unit.population: consumer device documentation, not an individual validation cohort
evidence_unit.conditions: daily RHR from inactive awake background samples; HRV from still background tachograms and active Breathe sessions
evidence_unit.comparison: field generation and sampling modes; no personal reference interval
evidence_unit.missing: measurement availability depends on motion and signal quality
evidence_unit.conclusion: ordinary heart rate is not daily RHR; active and background HRV protocols can differ
evidence_unit.cannot_infer: current user firmware applicability or personal recovery; no thresholds transferred

evidence_unit.comparison: field identity, not an all-day ordinary HR mean
evidence_unit.cannot_infer: recording quality or personal physiology from existence alone

units.reading_scope: selected original sections, methods and boundaries

evidence_unit.conditions: normal-to-normal interval standard deviation, time units

units.reading_scope: selected original sections, methods and boundaries

evidence_unit.population: adult development/held-out PSG validation; clinical set separately reported
evidence_unit.conditions: accelerometer stage classification; algorithm update changes quiet wake detection
evidence_unit.comparison: epochs versus PSG, held-out from development; version-specific
evidence_unit.missing: 2024 short-session binary asleep/wake can lack full staging
evidence_unit.conclusion: duration remains meaningful without stages; version changes affect comparability
evidence_unit.cannot_infer: a short detected event must be a nap or non-wear; individual stage correction from group accuracy

units.reading_scope: selected original sections, methods and boundaries

evidence_unit.conditions: general health consensus, not one recorded night
evidence_unit.missing: does not identify non-wear or authorize missing-night imputation
evidence_unit.conclusion: age and habitual true sleep matter; unknown/minor/out-of-scope age cannot inherit adult guidance
evidence_unit.cannot_infer: individual sleep need or a diagnosis from short device records

numeric_units.meaning: population consensus recommendation at least this on a regular basis

evidence_unit.device: standardized HRV protocol; full equipment details unverified
evidence_unit.conditions: training phases and randomized within-week observation subsets; morning protocol fulltext unverified
evidence_unit.missing: subset compliance study, not missing raw IBI
evidence_unit.conclusion: cannot convert lnRMSSD sampling research into Apple SDNN minimum days
evidence_unit.cannot_infer: full-text verification, Apple protocol or personal action threshold

numeric_units.meaning: abstract author recommendation under studied lnRMSSD protocol

evidence_unit.device: supine and standing vagally mediated HRV protocol; fulltext unverified
evidence_unit.conclusion: standing RMSSD increased in both functional overreaching and improved performance conditions; subjective tolerance needed
evidence_unit.cannot_infer: Apple SDNN validity, generalized fatigue diagnosis, completed fulltext review
